message_2_body:
Tim — appreciate the quick read and the redlines.

Summary of our end-to-end plan so everyone's on the same page (authorization latch model):
1) Internal approvals required: Procurement (PO), Legal sign-off on SOW, and Executive sign-off for the onboarding milestone.
2) Signature timing: we propose a two-step signature latch:
   - Step A (Authorization latch): Legal & Procurement OK — this triggers SOW finalization and DocuSign routing. Target: 09/30 EOD PT.
   - Step B (Operational latch): Once signatures are complete, we finalize capacity reservation and schedule the kickoff — target start date: 10/15 (14-day onboarding).
3) Buffer and handoffs: We will hold a 24-hour buffer after the Authorization latch to ensure the billing/PO is in place. If PO arrives after the buffer, start date slips by one week.

Attachments I'm sending now: the draft SOW (RDW_SOW_Acme_draft_v3.docx) with our tracked changes and a token-level cost worksheet. Please confirm that Acme's legal accepts the updated indemnity language on page 4; if not, flag the specific clause and we'll open a narrow redline pass.

If we get confirmation that 09/30 EOD is okay for the Authorization latch, Lauren (our Head of Sales Ops) will be prepared to send the DocuSign route and hit the EOD signature window.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
